purpose: Compare two fixed camera hypotheses on one plane and on independently declared off-plane points; no camera fit.

image.pixel_convention: continuous image-edge coordinates, top-left origin, centre (256,256); not raster-index centres

oracle.method: Independent rational pinhole calculation from these declared scalar parameters, without Blender matrices or view_frame.

interpretation.intrinsics_status: focal length deliberately unknown between the two hypotheses
interpretation.point_provenance: Own synthetic coordinates fixed before execution; no real survey or image measurements.
interpretation.same_plane_holdout_meaning: Labels excluded from the four facade corners; no fitting is performed on either set.
interpretation.off_plane_holdout_meaning: Coordinates never used to choose or fit the cameras; illustrative independently declared controls.
interpretation.occlusion: NOT_TESTED; no opaque facade mesh or ray test; real visibility would need separate evidence.
